payload.text: **ST0007 WP-05** (confirm, tag, push, object), after WP-04. Push through release_git_remote (GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, ssh BatchMode, </dev/null; tag -a always with -m, never an editor), the object through release_gh. **AC-5.3's confirm calls ask_person <question> (lib/helpers, b729e10)**: prints '<question> [y/N] ', reads /dev/tty, returns 0 on y, 1 on anything else, 2 when nobody can be asked (no readable /dev/tty or DEVBIN_GATE_TTY != 1). Gated callers only, so release's confirm runs inside a gate; map 2 to release's exit 2.
